tree.heading: Authority preserved
tree.text: Nothing in this chapter supersedes or limits the authority of any agency to carry out its responsibilities and missions under other laws.

tree.heading: Regulatory authority
tree.text: Nothing in this chapter may be construed as establishing new regulatory authority for any agency.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 608 of Pub. L. 105–383 was renumbered section 609 and is classified to section 4008 of this title.
